1.english_reference: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said ,

traditions.KJV: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said ,

traditions.KJV: Can a man be profitable unto God ,

traditions.KJV: as he that is wise may be profitable unto himself ?

traditions.KJV: or [ is it ] gain [ to him ] , that thou makest thy ways perfect ?

traditions.LXX: πότερον οὐχ ἡ κακία σού ἐστι πολλή ,

traditions.LXX: ἀναρίθμητοι δέ σού εἰσιν αἱ ἁμαρτίαι ;

traditions.KJV: and stripped the naked of their clothing .

traditions.KJV: Thou hast not given water to the weary to drink ,

traditions.KJV: and thou hast withholden bread from the hungry .

traditions.KJV: Thou hast sent widows away empty ,

traditions.KJV: and the arms of the fatherless have been broken .

traditions.KJV: [ Is ] not God in the height of heaven ?

traditions.KJV: and behold the height of the stars , how high they are !

traditions.KJV: And thou sayest , How doth God know ?

traditions.KJV: can he judge through the dark cloud ?

traditions.KJV: and he walketh in the circuit of heaven .

traditions.KJV: whose foundation was overflown with a flood :
